data.title: Nautica
data.about:
In the heart of Dubai Maritime City stands Nautica by Select Group, a majestic 49-level beacon of unrivaled luxury. This architectural triumph beautifully blends maritime charm with contemporary sophistication.

From Waterfront studios, Spacious 1 bedroom and expansive two-bedroom apartments Nautica offers seaside living with every unit echoing a symphony of meticulous design, premium fixtures, and breathtaking ocean vistas.

Strategically poised to offer residents an upscale lifestyle, Nautica doesn't just promise a home; it assures an experience. Delight in amenities like the pristine swimming pool, state-of-the-art fitness center, and curated gardens. Beyond the walls, an array of retail and dining options await. With floor-to-ceiling windows inviting in the serene ocean ambiance, living at Nautica at Dubai Maritime City means cherishing every moment where urban elegance meets maritime serenity.

location_tile.title: Located in Dubai Maritime City
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nautica graces the heart of Dubai Maritime City, radiating sophistication and allure. Perfectly anchored between Port Rashid and Drydocks World, its position is truly unmatched. Nestled amidst the pulsating rhythm of the maritime sector, residents are promised a lively and cosmopolitan way of life. With major touchpoints like Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and the iconic Dubai Mall/Burj Khalifa just a stone's throw away, connectivity is a breeze.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 10 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach Coastline
  • 10 Minutes to  Pearl Jumeirah
  • 15 Minutes to Gold Souk / Creek Tower
  • 20 Minutes to The Dubai Mall
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai International Financial Centre
